body:
leo: FYI FRA inbound shipment hit a customs photo inspection. Forwarder says hold + 10-14 day ETA delay for sea top-up. 32 units total, 5 DOA reported on receipt. Need split routing, credit terms, and RMA flow.
vendor-liaison: We logged RMA 2026-882. DOA serials attached in ticket. We can offer a split: immediate air replacements for up to 22 units, remaining 10 by sea. Air premium +$1100/unit.
nadia: Please paste the DOA serials here so depot can start the RMAs. Vendor also: confirm HS code & if invoice was amended to avoid repeated holds.
vendor-liaison: DOA serials: SN-Z7X6W5V4, SN-Z7X6W5V5, SN-Z7X6W5V6, SN-Z7X6W5V7, SN-Z7X6W5V8. HS 8471.50.80. Commercial invoice amended and re-filed.
ops-lead: Cost check: 22 air units * $1100 = $24,200. Vendor proposes 85% pre-credit on DOAs, balance after depot photos. Can vendor shift to 92% if Redwood covers AWB expedite charges?
vendor-liaison: We can do 92% pre-credit if Redwood covers AWB expedite. AWB will be billed to REF RDW-PO-4499.
finance-bot: Finance needs a written billing ref and PO match to pre-authorize. Vendor please confirm in one line.
rma-bot: RMA 2026-882 status: pending-photos. Upload depot photos within 72h to prevent holdback.
leo: Decision: approve 92% pre-credit and AWB coverage for the 22 air units; divert 8 units to AMS edge (lower customs friction) instead of FRA. Send SLA and billing ref ASAP.
vendor-liaison: SLA: "Dispatch up to 22 air replacements within 48h of pre-credit confirmation; 92% pre-credit on DOA serials issued upon pre-authorization; remaining 8% issued after depot photo verification; AWB billed to Redwood account REF: RDW-PO-4499."
ops-lead: I'll arrange depot photo uploads and tag RMA 2026-882. Nadia please attach amended invoice & HS code to customs alias.
nadia: On it. Looping customs contact now.
finance-bot: Received SLA & billing ref. Initiating pre-credit workflow.
leo: Thanks team. I'll monitor ETA and confirm when AMS diversion executed. :thumbsup:
